lesson.summary:
Past continuous dibentuk dengan *was/were + V-ing*. Bentuk ini dipakai untuk sesuatu yang sedang berlangsung pada satu waktu tertentu di masa lalu: *At 9 p.m. yesterday I was watching a film.* Pada pukul 9 aksinya sudah dimulai dan belum selesai.

Bandingkan dengan past simple, yang menyatakan aksi utuh yang sudah selesai. *I was walking home* menceritakan prosesnya. *I walked home* menceritakan seluruh kejadiannya.

Kedua bentuk ini sering dipakai bersama. Aksi panjang (latar) memakai past continuous, sedangkan aksi pendek yang terjadi di tengahnya memakai past simple: *While Sinta was cooking, the phone rang. When the lights went off, we were having dinner.*

Kata kerja keadaan seperti *know, want, understand* tetap memakai past simple: *I didn't know what to do* (bukan *wasn't knowing*).

patterns.formula: I / he / she / it + was + V-ing

patterns.example: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
When she arrived, we started eating.

examples.en: At 9 p.m. yesterday I was watching a film.
examples.id: Jam 9 malam kemarin saya sedang menonton film.

examples.en: When the electricity went off, we were having dinner.
examples.id: Waktu listrik padam, kami sedang makan malam.

examples.en: While Sinta was cooking, the phone rang.
examples.id: Saat Sinta sedang memasak, teleponnya berdering.

examples.en: Dodi fell off his bike while he was riding home.
examples.id: Dodi jatuh dari sepeda saat sedang bersepeda pulang.

examples.en: It was raining when I left the office, so I took a taxi.
examples.id: Hujan sedang turun waktu saya keluar kantor, jadi saya naik taksi.

examples.en: I didn't know what to do, so I asked my boss.
examples.id: Saya tidak tahu harus berbuat apa, jadi saya bertanya kepada atasan.

commonMistakes.wrong: I was walking home when it was starting to rain.
commonMistakes.right: I was walking home when it started to rain.
commonMistakes.why: Aksi pendek yang memotong aksi panjang memakai past simple.

commonMistakes.wrong: I was seeing an accident on my way home.
commonMistakes.right: I saw an accident on my way home.
commonMistakes.why: *see* adalah aksi singkat dan kata kerja keadaan, jadi memakai past simple.

commonMistakes.wrong: When the guests arrived, we still cooked the rice.
commonMistakes.right: When the guests arrived, we were still cooking the rice.
commonMistakes.why: Prosesnya sedang berlangsung saat tamu datang.

questions.sentence: At 9 o'clock last night I {{1}} a film.
questions.explanation: Sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu di masa lalu: was watching.

questions.sentence: When the electricity went off, we {{1}} dinner.
questions.explanation: Aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat kejadian lain terjadi: were having.
Pertanyaan past continuous: What were you doing …?

questions.sentence: It {{1}} when I left the office, so I took a taxi.
questions.explanation: Latar kejadian: hujan sedang turun.

questions.instruction: Tulis bentuk yang tepat: past continuous atau past simple.
questions.explanation: Aksi panjang: was cooking. Aksi pendek yang memotongnya: rang (ring → rang).

questions.sentence: I {{1}} when the teacher explained the homework.
questions.explanation: Negatif past continuous: wasn't (was not) listening.

questions.instruction: Tulis bentuk yang tepat: past continuous atau past simple.
questions.sentence: Dodi {{1}} off his bike while he {{2}} home.
questions.explanation: Aksi pendek: fell (fall → fell). Aksi panjang: was riding.

questions.sentence: We {{1}} along the beach when we saw a turtle.
questions.explanation: Aksi panjang yang sedang berlangsung: were walking.

questions.sentence: I ___ my phone while I was running for the bus.

options.why: Benar. Aksi singkat yang terjadi di tengah aksi panjang memakai past simple.
Menjatuhkan HP adalah aksi singkat, bukan proses yang berlangsung lama.
Kalimatnya tentang masa lalu, jadi perlu bentuk lampau.

questions.explanation: Aksi singkat: past simple. Latar yang sedang berlangsung: past continuous.

questions.sentence: This time yesterday we ___ on the beach in Bali.

options.why: Past simple menceritakan aksi utuh. this time yesterday menunjuk ke tengah-tengah aksi.
Benar. Sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu kemarin.

questions.explanation: this time yesterday / at 8 p.m. last night + past continuous.

questions.sentence: When Rina phoned, I ___ dinner, so I couldn't answer.

options.why: cooked menceritakan aksi utuh, tidak menjelaskan bahwa saya sedang sibuk memasak saat telepon berdering.
Benar. Saya sedang memasak saat Rina menelepon, jadi tidak bisa mengangkat.

questions.explanation: Aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat kejadian lain terjadi: past continuous.

questions.sentence: I ___ what to do, so I asked my boss.

options.why: Benar. know adalah kata kerja keadaan, jadi memakai past simple.
know tidak dipakai dalam bentuk continuous.
was tidak digabung dengan bentuk dasar kata kerja.

questions.explanation: Kata kerja keadaan (know, want, understand) memakai past simple.

questions.hint: Apa yang sedang kamu lakukan jam sepuluh tadi?
questions.explanation: What + were + you + V-ing + waktu.

questions.hint: Saya sedang tidur waktu kamu menelepon.
questions.explanation: Aksi panjang (was sleeping) + when + aksi pendek (called).

questions.hint: Mereka tidak sedang bekerja waktu itu.
questions.explanation: Negatif: weren't + V-ing.

questions.hint: Dia jatuh saat sedang menuruni tangga.
questions.explanation: Aksi pendek (fell) + while + aksi panjang (was going down).

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: When the guests arrived, we were still cooking the rice.
questions.explanation: Prosesnya sedang berlangsung saat tamu datang: were still cooking.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: I saw an accident on my way home.
questions.explanation: see adalah aksi singkat/keadaan: saw.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
questions.explanation: Kalimatnya tentang masa lalu. Aksi panjang yang terpotong hujan: was walking.

questions.instruction: Ketuk bagian yang salah, lalu tulis perbaikannya.
questions.corrected: We were playing football when it started to rain.
questions.explanation: Hujan mulai turun adalah aksi singkat yang memotong: started.
